{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''The False War''''' was a manifesto written by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] and [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] as part of [[Gender/Legends|his]] work ''[[Absolute Power]]''.

The volume detailed how the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] were an essential part of [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane's]] [[Grand Plan/Legends|Grand Plan]] for [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] re-emergence and dominance in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
